title: Viski Tutkununun El Kitabı
author: Burkay Adalığ
description: The Complete Whisky Guide is a concise guide to the culture and craft of whisky. Burkay Adalığ explains how whisky is made, how maturation and cask types shape flavor, and how to taste, pair, store, and collect whisky with confidence. Designed for both beginners and experienced enthusiasts, the book offers practical insight into appreciating whisky as a refined and timeless spirit.
